name: Woven Rattan Storage Basket
description: A hand-woven rattan storage basket with tapered sides, a reinforced rolled rim, and two woven loop handles.
materials: Natural rattan cane, hand-woven construction with a reinforced rolled rim and woven loop handles.
negativeConstraints: Never render any text, tag, label, or brand mark on the basket; keep the weave pattern natural and non-repeating; never add dyed color or painted rattan.
preservationNotes: Keep the same tapered round basket silhouette, diagonal hand-woven pattern, rolled rim, and two symmetrical loop handles consistent across all five angles.
